content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 -> embedder-eu service high 5xx rate. threshold=50rps, current=220rps, error_rate=18%. affects: 3 customers (prod). runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embedder-5xx :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-1457 created and routed to oncall (Maya). escalation in 6m if no ack.
Maya (oncall): acked. i'll take initial triage, spinning up bridge now -> https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-1457 :point_up:
Anya Patel: thx. ETA to join? i can help with metrics and quick rollback if needed.
Maya (oncall): join in 30s. quick check — looks like spikes coincide with model-cache GC on hosts eu-gpu-14..eu-gpu-17.
Ravi Chen: copying logs from the prod tail (filtered):
```
2026-03-17T12:10:05Z embedder worker eu-gpu-14 ERR "kv cache eviction 42% used -> miss burst"
2026-03-17T12:10:06Z embedder request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_timeout
2026-03-17T12:10:07Z embedder worker eu-gpu-15 WARN "queue depth 128"
```
Maya (oncall): looks like prefix/KV cache thrash causing backend timeouts. runbook suggests fallback to smaller kv-window and scale up replicas.
Anya Patel: i can trigger a temporary scale: `kubectl scale deploy/embedder-eu --replicas=8 -n prod` — should add capacity and reduce queue. want me to run? :+1:
Maya (oncall): go ahead. also switching routing to canary-variant `embedder-v2-smallcache` as fallback. doing now.
pagerduty: Note: escalation timer paused after ack by Maya.
Ravi Chen: i'll take customer comms. pinging CSMs with an initial note: "we're investigating an embedding outage in EU, mitigation in progress, ETA 10-20m".
ops-lead: keep timeline notes in the incident doc: https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-1457/notes
Maya (oncall): scale triggered by Anya completed — replicas -> 8, CPU ok. routing switched to fallback variant. monitoring error_rate...
Maya (oncall): error_rate dropped to 6% in the last 45s, QPS stable at 90. continuing to monitor for 10m.
Anya Patel: logs show reduced timeouts. i'll leave autoscaler disabled for a short window to avoid thrash: `kubectl annotate deploy/embedder-eu autoscaler/paused=true`
Ravi Chen: CSM update sent: "mitigation applied, partial service restored, we will follow up with postmortem and impacts."
Maya (oncall): adding action items: 1) investigate root cause of cache thrash (postmortem) 2) add circuit-breaker for kv eviction 3) adjust autoscaler triggers 4) notify affected customers with RCA.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1457 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated (partial). paging escalation will resume if error_rate > 10% for 5m.
Maya (oncall): handing off monitoring watches to Anya for next 30m, then Ravi for customer comms. tagging @ops-lead for postmortem owner.
Anya Patel: taking watch. i'll ping if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
Ravi Chen: standing by for customer followups.
ops-lead: assigned postmortem to me, will coordinate with infra/release.
Maya (oncall): closing live handoff. will update incident doc after bridge. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
